inputs.text: pencilart, hand colour this exact fantasy map with beautiful coloured pencils and translucent watercolour. Preserve the precise cartographic composition, all existing coastlines, river banks, trees, mountains, roads, buildings and every delicate black pencil line. Add fresh moss and emerald green to forests and meadows, turquoise and soft azure blue to the rivers and lakes, earthy ochre paths, slate blue and warm grey mountain stone, tiny terracotta rooftops and golden fields. Rich inviting natural colours with visible white paper between fine pencil strokes. A magical literary atlas, bright and inspiring, finely observed and mature. Keep the spacious central clearing very pale and almost unpainted for typography. Paint the existing drawing only: do not add, remove, move or redesign anything. No lettering, no text, no labels, no symbols, no border, no yellow parchment, no heavy shadows, no solid dark fills.
